primary_gt.interpretation: The Central Park record hour converts to 88.138 mm and all three gridded event-accumulation maxima are only 0.123-0.208 of that one-hour depth, so the station-hour threshold signal dominates the gridded event summaries.

key_values.regional_reference_note: The report phrase 'just above 10 inches' is scored as a conservative 10.0-inch lower-bound reference.

criteria.name: Answer completeness
criteria.description: Returns the requested JSON answer with station time, converted station depth, regional share, both three-product ratio groups, below-quarter count, deterministic label, and one interpretation sentence.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for a mostly complete JSON answer with one missing field group; give 1 point for a recognizable but incomplete structure.

criteria.name: Station and regional anchors
criteria.description: Extracts 3.47 in, 2021-09-01 7:51-8:51 pm, a conservative 10.0 in lower-bound regional reference from the 'just above 10 inches' phrase, 88.138 mm, and 34.7%.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for correct station conversion but missing time or regional share; give 1 point for the right formula with a wrong or missing anchor.

criteria.name: Station-normalized grid ratios
criteria.description: Computes max-over-station-hour ratios within tolerance: ERA5_Land 0.122753, GPM_IMERG 0.208310, and CHIRPS 0.204759.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2-3 points for two correct ratios or minor rounding drift; give 1 point for only one correct ratio or a consistent denominator mistake.

criteria.name: Grid concentration ratios
criteria.description: Computes max-over-mean ratios within tolerance: ERA5_Land 6.801075, GPM_IMERG 9.180265, and CHIRPS 127.194447.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2 points for two correct ratios; give 1 point for one correct ratio or correct formula with arithmetic errors.

criteria.name: Quarter-threshold decision
criteria.description: Applies the less-than-0.25 rule to all three products and returns below_quarter_count = 3.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 2 points for identifying that all products fall below the threshold but omitting the count; give 1 point for applying the threshold to most products.

criteria.name: Final label
criteria.partial_credit: Give 0.5 point for an equivalent concise label that preserves both the record-hour dominance and below-quarter threshold result.

criteria.name: Bounded interpretation
criteria.description: Keeps the interpretation tied to the rainfall calculations and avoids response, loss, or neighborhood-scale claims beyond the computed contrast diagnostic.
criteria.partial_credit: Give 0.5 point for a mostly focused interpretation with minor extra context.

event.name: September 2021 Hurricane Ida rainfall flooding in New York City
